name: Balloons
desc: A field of party balloons drifting upward with lazy sway and knotted strings, from softly-modelled matte latex to abstract latitude-longitude wireframe globes and misregistered riso prints.

style.doc: matte=soft-modelled latex (no outline) / riso=2-ink halftone misregistration / foil=iridescent mylar specular / wire=abstract lat-long wireframe globe / ink=sumi tonal wash

act.doc: drift=steady rise / updraft=rise pumps with section intensity+bass / bob=heavier sway
